description: Header file defining the WifiManager class, which implements Wi-Fi management functionalities and JSONRPC communication for a plugin within the WPEFramework. It includes method declarations for Wi-Fi operations, event handlers, and interface implementations.

classes.name: WifiManager
classes.description: A plugin class managing Wi-Fi operations and JSONRPC communication within WPEFramework.

methods.name: getQuirks
methods.description: Retrieves Wi-Fi quirks based on parameters.

methods.name: getConnectedSSID
methods.description: Retrieves the SSID of the currently connected network.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects to a specified Wi-Fi network.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects from the current Wi-Fi network.

methods.name: saveSSID
methods.description: Saves an SSID for future connection.

methods.name: getPairedSSIDInfo
methods.description: Gets information about the paired SSID.

methods.name: isPaired
methods.description: Checks if a device is paired.

methods.name: setSignalThresholdChangeEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables signal threshold change notifications.

methods.name: isSignalThresholdChangeEnabled
methods.description: Checks if signal threshold change notifications are enabled.

methods.name: onWIFIStateChanged
methods.description: Event handler for Wi-Fi state changes.

methods.name: onSSIDsChanged
methods.description: Event handler for SSID list changes.

methods.name: onWifiSignalThresholdChanged
methods.description: Event handler for signal strength changes.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the service.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of WifiManager.
